summary: Converts POP points or attributes into TOP pixels. By default it maps P position to 32-bit float image channels and uses alpha as an active-pixel mask.

key_params.name: extract
key_params.note: Point, vertex, or primitive attribute extraction

key_params.name: layout
key_params.note: Fit, wrap, crop, or use POP dimension

key_concepts: P position as 32-bit float image channels
Position and Active versus Custom modes
point, vertex, and primitive attribute extraction
Fit to Square, Wrapped, Cropped, and POP Dimension layouts
common_gotchas: POP to TOP is a data conversion, not a shaded render; use Render Simple TOP or Render TOP for visible geometry.
Inactive pixels have alpha 0, so downstream TOP logic should account for the active mask.
Use POP Dimension layout when the POP already has meaningful row/column/depth dimensions.
